# Party And Leader Appendix

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cses_wiki.py. Review before manual editing. -->

## Purpose

Use this when asked how to format, check, or explain party and leader appendix entries.

## Use When

Keywords and signals: party, leader, appendix, coalition.

## Standard Workflow

1. List the party name in the original language first.
2. Place the abbreviation after the original-language party name.
3. Add the English party name below when applicable.
4. List leaders only when leader data exist for that party.
5. Use double line spacing between appendix entries.
6. Use template examples for formatting checks and the decision memorandum for policy questions.
